prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1258; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this office represents our client in connection with a collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection and was struck by another vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is pursuing a claim for the losses arising from it.

Effective immediately, all communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, recorded interviews, medical authorizations, or settlement discussions, must be directed exclusively to this firm. Please do not contact our client directly.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits applicable to the policy covering the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including photographs, vehicle data, claim file materials, witness statements, recorded calls, and any telematics or dash camera footage. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt response.
